# Crocoddyl Free Forward Dynamics: Center of Mass Cost is Not Effective and Jcom is Zero, Is This a Caching Error?

> **Current answer:** In the free forward dynamics model used in this Issue, there is no caching error: the maintainer explains that the model does not update the global center of mass (CoM) information by design, therefore maintaining shared CoM and Jcom at zero. The issue should first be resolved by using an action model that matches the contact/center-of-mass task, or explicitly calculating and evaluating the real-time cost.

## Key terms

- Center of Mass (CoM) (质心)
- Jacobian Matrix (雅可比矩阵)
- Forward Dynamics (前向动力学)

## Problem and symptoms

- The trajectory remains unchanged after adding the center of mass cost.
- data.shared.pinocchio.com[0] and Jcom are both zero; manual invocation of the center of mass function becomes effective but slows down.

## Environment

- Crocoddyl DifferentialActionModelFreeFwdDynamics and Pinocchio share data.

## Priority diagnostics

- First confirm whether the current differential action model updates the global center of mass data as per design.

## Possible causes

- The free forward dynamics model defaults to not updating the global center of mass information.

## Attempts

- The user directly calls centerOfMass and jacobianCenterOfMass in the cost.

## Effective fixes

- Select a model that updates the required shared data according to the task motivation, or explicitly calculate and accept additional cost.

## Result

- After the maintainer explains the design boundary, the original author confirms the issue is resolved and the Issue is closed.

## Limitations

- The maintainer also questions the physical motivation for controlling the global center of mass in free forward dynamics; this cannot be extrapolated to contact dynamics models.
